EA Origin On the House: Need For Speed Most Wanted by Criterion for FREE for a limited time
Does anyone know how the Criterion remake lives up to the original '05 NFS:MW version?

I never played the REmake back in the day of release, I heard different opinions some say its a good game others say its a bad compared to original.

From what I remember about original MW compared to Criterion game is that in REmake there are no Live Action FMV so far from 1,5h of game time in REmake. In remake the car customization is smaller compared to original, different city, different soundtracks if I'm right, but maybe they put some remakes from original. The intro track in REmake is Muse - Butterflies and Hurricanes. Less boss battles compared to original Most Wanted Blacklist (11 vs 15). In my case the controls on controller feel strange, like there is sort of input lag or maybe because of my controller (DS3). Visually is beautiful game, there are many option for PC enthusiast to tweak, even Supersampling which is a surprise to me for a 2012 game. I could say that it plays like Burnout by Criterion, and feels like the previous title in NFS Series Hot Pursuit by Criterion; they borrowed some features and design aspects from Burnout games and based on that they created their own NFS games. The game runs smooth on my PC, can't complain. Since my last NFS game Hot Pursuit by Criterion, I have to say that I enjoy Most Wanted 2012 so far.

It's been quite a lot of time since I played the original so i may forgot a lot of details, about it like what type of mods there are or how big is the city to free roam. So you may check for yourself other overviews. I hope this helped. :)
